message: 祝福
Whose blow was it that settled the battle? I don't know.
Even if I knew, I don't think it would mean anything.
Because it wasn't just one of us who drove back Re-Crea--it was all of us together.
Suddenly, the raging power stopped.
It was as if time had stood still.
An instant later, the light enveloping Bylous shifted into seven colors, cracked, and shattered without a sound.
The countless shattered fragments of light became shooting stars gleaming like jewels, raining down upon us, the people watching over us, and Bylous, who stood frozen in a daze.

name: Bylous
message: 「What... is this... What is the meaning of this...」

name: Misa
message: 「Wh-What is this?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa! It's gonna hit me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh... It actually feels kinda nice?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Getting pleasure from having things hit you... Madam Treasurer, you're a pervert.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's your deal?! I can't help it if it feels good!」

name: Misa
message: 「It really does... It feels kinda nice... Or rather, warm...」

name: Misa
message: 「And I am definitely not a pervert!」

name: Ria
message: 「It's true...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-I'm in a pinch, surrounded by perverts!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「B-But it really does feel nice.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even Amyrina! Aah, your mother must have raised you poorly! Or is it childhood trauma?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Don't worry, Lolotte-chan, I'll make you a fellow pervert in no time.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa, whoa! Don't put me in a full nelson! Help me, Jeeves!」

name: Riesling
message: 「My deepest apologies, Milady. I have already become a pervert ahead of you.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wah! It's gonna hit me! Huh~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...This actually feels pretty good! Who was the one shouting about perverts earlier?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That was you.」
A shooting star struck my forehead as well.
The spot where it touched took on a soft, seven-colored glow.
The moment it touched me.
A warmth like a sunlit spot enveloped me.
Why was a fragment of the ominous Re-Crea so gentle?

name: Melilot
message: 「This is... something born from Re-Crea, the reenactment of the very beginning of all things.」

name: Melilot
message: 「If so, while it is expressed in various languages, in alchemy it is called Prima Materia. The primordial substance that composes the world.」

name: Synn
message: 「Prima materia?」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is an ephemeral yet eternal substance used by God when creating the world--capable of transforming into anything, yet once transformed, impossible to revert save by an act of God.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then does that mean I, Azel, and you too, Melilot, are all made of this?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, that is correct.」
I heard Azel's murmur.

name: Azel
message: 「It's a blessing...」
Azel, standing amidst the falling meteors, was the most beautiful sight I had ever seen.
Surely, it's moments like these that make people want to take a photograph.

name: Azel
message: 「Hey, Synn, this is a blessing!」
Clad in a soft, seven-colored light, Azel smiled innocently.

name: Azel
message: 「There's no way the Lord doesn't love a world He made out of something so gentle and warm!」

name: Azel
message: 「God is blessing us all!」
